<definition_of_ready maturity="Executable" cumulative="true">

Judge every criterion; this table includes the complete Proposed, Framed, and Sliced requirements.

| ID                          | Criterion                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `executable-record`         | All six front-matter fields and all four ordered top-level body sections satisfy the shared record contract.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `executable-identity`       | `title`, `product`, `maturity: Executable`, and `lifecycle` identify one intended Output, one Product, and a valid Lifecycle.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `executable-relationships`  | Root or successor lineage is complete and immutable; every known blocker is present; the dependency graph has no blocker cycle.                                                                                                                                                |
| `executable-output-value`   | `# Output` and `# Value` preserve the proposal and its established priority basis without received conversation input.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `executable-frame`          | Every affected or intended Node, Assertion operation, governing or intended Decision, per-node target malleability, repository boundary, and accountable person is identified; Output-affecting questions are settled and `# Frame` carries the operator's Intent attestation. |
| `executable-slice`          | The Change is one coherent, independently integrable unit in one repository with resolved dependencies and sequence.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `executable-decisions`      | Every consequential Decision for the changeset is settled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `executable-state-evidence` | `# Frame` states the required state and evidence obligations for every affected node.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `executable-activities`     | `# Activities` is ordered; its Activities are sufficient for Claude to proceed without further judgment.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `executable-authority`      | Advancement stays inside the operator-attested Frame; any reopened product or architecture judgment blocks advancement.                                                                                                                                                        |

</definition_of_ready>
